title: Adapter contract: how adapters present external systems to DS rules
preamble:
# Adapter contract: how adapters present external systems to DS rules

The contract an **adapter** signs when bridging an external system
into DS's fact model: what a rule author needs to know, and what any
adapter (HomeKit, Zigbee2MQTT, Matter, a custom REST adapter) must
honour to slot into the language without special-casing.

## What this is not

- Not a list of which specific adapters exist or what they each
  offer. Per-adapter content (schema catalogues, provider APIs,
  broker semantics) stays with each adapter doc.
- Not a wire-protocol spec. Wire formats, handshake mechanics,
  back-pressure policies belong with the runtime hosting each
  adapter; some relevant cross-tier bits live in
  [LFAC].
- Not a replacement for [LFAC] or
  [LEXP]. Those own the broader fact
  and expression surface. This doc is the narrower contract an
  adapter signs when bridging external systems into that surface.
- Not a blueprint for building an adapter. Adapter authors read
  this to know what DS expects; they build the rest per their
  own doc.
